projectRoot.description: Project root relative to the workspace root. Defaults to the current project root.

configFile.description: Path to an oxlint configuration file relative to the workspace root. When omitted, the executor discovers a default config in the project root.

fix.description: Fix as many issues as possible. Only unfixed issues are reported.

fixSuggestions.description: Apply auto-fixable suggestions. May change program behavior.

quiet.description: Disable reporting on warnings; only errors are reported.

maxWarnings.description: Force a non-zero exit when the warning count exceeds this threshold.

args.description: Additional CLI arguments forwarded to oxlint (e.g. ["--type-aware", "--react-plugin"]).
